name: oneshot_bounce_stretch
title: Bounce a one-shot, spectrally stretch, loop, and trim
material: short percussive gestures - drum hits, synth stabs, plucks
description: Builds a gesture from a single hit: bounce repeats it with accelerating, decaying echoes (physical ball-drop feel), stretch time expands the result 2.5x spectrally (keeping pitch), extend loop cuts a rhythmic cell, and sfedit cut trims an exact one-second window.
source: Verified end-to-end on a percussive sweep-hit proxy in the Phase 5 generalization matrix (tests/test_generalization.py, one-shot chain; docs/generalization-matrix.md).
notes: bounce duration follows the geometric gap series - count 5 / shorten 0.75 adds roughly one input-length of echoes.
spectral timestretch padding is proportionally largest on short inputs (observed +2% at ~1.2 s) - trim after, not before.
sfedit cut start/end are seconds into the file at THAT node - the dry-run duration predictions tell you what is available.
